Name: Hilary of Poitiers
Summary: Bishop of Poitiers in Gaul in the fourth century, a leading Western defender of Nicene orthodoxy against Arian teaching.
Contribution: His treatise On the Trinity gave the Latin West a careful statement of the Son's full divinity, and his exile for opposing Arian bishops did not silence his defence of the Nicene faith.
Testimony: Accepted exile rather than compromise on the divinity of Christ.
